response.original_title: Can I Add Another Passenger to My Celebrity Cruise Reservation?
response.overview: To add a passenger on a Celebrity Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) reservation, you must call Celebrity Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly at 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK), as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a passenger to a Celebrity Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) online, so you must contact Celebrity customer service or your travel agent directly by phone  1-877-525-6540. To add another passenger to an existing Celebrity Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) booking, you must call customer service directly or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.
